snippet.title: Potions Galore - Official Reveal Trailer | Cozy Puzzle Tidy-up
snippet.description:
Potions Galore is a cozy sorting game where you organize over 2900 potion bottles in their respective shelves.

Read labels and encyclopaedia descriptions, then use your intuition to find the correct placement and tidy up the mess.

Wishlist now on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/5079620
